howtos.title: Audit bank CSVs with a Claude CFO prompt
howtos.what: Export 12 months of bank CSVs and have Claude find cuts, keeps, and renegotiations without account access.
copy: Be my CFO. Find every place I lose money, biggest first. Remove transfers between my own accounts so nothing counts twice. List every recurring charge, with its price and next renewal. Ask me 5 to 10 questions before you give advice. Then tell me what to CUT, KEEP, or RENEGOTIATE, with yearly savings. Use code for every number. Never ask for a password or account number.
howtos.whenToUse: When you want a spend audit from local bank CSVs without giving Claude account logins.
